content: Ta ishuntho, ta kunthi wozinar ta amottizaynnee Xoossa woossizay Isreelitay attod garkke.
Unttii Xoossis micinttizazin, tuma eretith dhabor micinttoozana ta markkattiza.
Unttii Xooss xillotith oge eraam ixxii, fa aadda xillotith kaalleezapp attin Xooss xillotith koyekkaya.
As ubbay ammanor xillod garkk Kiristtoosa higges folo maaqqeeza.
Atotithii ubbitayisii
Muse asii higge naagii ekkiz xillotithibaz, «Higge naagiz oonkka ye higga naageezay garkk de7o yezoda» yeegeeza.
Zin ammanor ekkiz xillotith bagga giinttintteezay yhaya: «Ne wozinar, ‹Oonii salo kezode?» yeegippe; yey Kiristtoosa wothodayis.
Woy, «Sulle sa7a oommo wodhdhoday oonoo?» giippe; yey Kiristtoosa duufopp kessodayis.
Zin yeegii xaafintteez: «Qaalay ne kale yeza; ne doona ganccennee ne wozina gancce yeza» Nuunii yinttis odiz ammano qaalay yhaya.
«Yesuusa Goda» gi ne doonar markkatikonnee Xoossay eza yhayiqopp dentheezana ne wozinar ammaniko, ne attoda.
Asii fa wozinar ammanii xilliza; fa doonar markkattii attiza.
Maxaafay, «Eza ammaniza oonkka yeellattenna» yeegeeza.
Pettii Xoossay ubbitay Goda maaqqeez gishos Ayihuditay ganccennee Ayihude baa as gancce dummatithii baaya. E fana xeegiz ubbayis gaame keeha.
Goda sunth xeegiz oonkka attoda.
Yeezin, unttii ammanekka yezttar wayizii eza xeegodayis danda7ee? U ebaz si7ekka yezttar wayizii eza ammanodayis danda7inee? Ma unttis qaala odiz as baazin, wayizii si7odayis danda7inee?
Kiitintteez asii baazin qaalay wayizii odinttodayis danda7ee? Maxaafayid, «Ufayss wonggile odiz asis tokitay waafa lo77ineshsha» yeegii xaafintteeza.
Zin Isiyaasa, «Godayyo, nu markkatith oonii ammaneenee?» yeegeezay garkk, ubbitay wonggile ammanekkaya.
Yey gishos, ammanay sisapp yi7iza; sissi Kiristtoosa qaalapp yi7iza.
Maaqqozin, u Qaala si7ibe7ekka guussonnee? Wa77a si7eeza. Maxsaafayid,

content.text: u qaalay sa7a gaxa helleeza» yeegintteeza.
